claims: The Philadelphia Phillies and left-handed pitcher Cristopher Sánchez agreed to a six-year, $107 million contract extension on March 22, 2026.
The contract extension runs through the 2032 season.
The contract extension replaces Cristopher Sánchez's previous contract.
The contract extension includes a 2033 club option.
The total guarantee of the contract extension is $107 million covering 2027–2032.
The contract extension keeps Cristopher Sánchez's scheduled $6 million salary for 2027 from his previous contract.
The contract extension keeps Cristopher Sánchez's scheduled $9 million salary for 2028 from his previous contract.
The salary under the contract extension is $15 million in 2029.
The salary under the contract extension is $16 million in 2030.
The salary under the contract extension is $30 million in 2031.
The salary under the contract extension is $30 million in 2032.
The 2033 club option is $44.5 million with a $1 million buyout.
The contract extension includes over $13 million in performance bonuses.
Cristopher Sánchez's agent is Mato Sports Management.
In 2025, Cristopher Sánchez went 13-5 with a 2.50 ERA.
In 2025, Cristopher Sánchez ranked second in the NL Cy Young voting.
In 2025, Cristopher Sánchez led all MLB pitchers with 8.0 bWAR.
The contract extension keeps Cristopher Sánchez in Philadelphia alongside Aaron Nola and Zack Wheeler through the end of the decade.
